title: Ubusitani Bwazimye mu ijoro rimwe
intro: Tekereza ubusitani butoshye, bwuzuyemo imbuto zeze kandi bukikijwe n'ibiti birebire. Ababushinzwe bibwiraga ko ari abanyabwenge, bategura isarura ryabo mu masaha y'ituze mbere y'uko bucya, kure y'amaso y'ababukeneye. Ariko Udasinzira yari afite indi gahunda yo kubona ibyiza bye byihishe. Ese ushobora kwiyumvisha ni nde uhagaze inyuma y'iyi nkuru y'uburiganya yo muri Korowani?
clues: Twigeze kugira ubusitani bwiza kandi bunini ku buryo bwabaye ishyari ry'abahanyuraga bose.
Mu gutegura gahunda yacu, twaganiriye kare mu gitondo, tuvuga ko nta muntu ukennye wemerewe kwinjira kuri uwo munsi.
Twari abantu b’abakire, kandi imitima yacu yari yarahumye amaso ku burenganzira bw’abakene bari badukikije.
Ubwo umuseke w'isarura twari twateganyije wageraga, twegereye ubusitani bwacu dusanga bwahindutse amatongo yijimye mu ijoro ryose.
Itegeko riteye ubwoba ryarasohoye, nta kindi risiga uretse ivu aho amatsinda y'imbuto zeze yari yamanitswe.
Inkuru yacu ni umuburo ukomeye wanditswe muri Korowani, aho tuzwiho kuba ba nyir'ubusitani babuzaga abakene impano.
